newsitem.title: USA: Paul Harris September same store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Paul Harris September same store sales up.

text.p: Paul Harris Stores Inc, a specialty retailer of private-label women's casual wear, said its September same store sales rose 35.3 percent over the comparable month last year.
The retailer also said that while it is too early to specifically discuss third quarter results, it now anticipates exceeding its goals for both sales and earnings.
Paul Harris officials were not immediately available to quantify the retailer's goals.
In its third quarter ended October 28, 1995, the company reported a loss of $0.06 a share on sales of $36.9 million.
September net sales, based on 10 percent fewer stores than a year ago, rose 32 percent to $18.3 million from $13.9 million a year ago.
Year-to-date same store sales were up 18 percent, it said. Year-to-date sales increased to $106.1 million from $96 million in 1995.

"We were confident that customer response to our new fall Paul Harris Design collection would be very positive. However, sales have thus far surpassed our expectations," said Charlotte Fischer, chairman, president and chief executive officer, in a statement.

Exceptionally strong sales in Paul Harris Design sweaters, collections and a new Paul Harris denim brand contributed to the month. The expanded accessories business was also a key contributor, she said.

The company opened eight stores in the past two months, two of which are new prototype stores located in major regional malls. Both prototype stores, which incorporate a number of new design and merchandising features, are performing above expectations, the company said.
Paul Harris sells private label apparel through 223 locations.
